name: spec-finder
description: A skill-driven specification framework and ACP cockpit

scripts.test:pty: sh -c 'if [ "$(uname -s)" != "Darwin" ]; then echo "test:pty requires macOS (Darwin)" >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ ! -x /usr/bin/script ]; then echo "test:pty requires executable /usr/bin/script" >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ ! -x /usr/bin/expect ]; then echo "test:pty requires executable /usr/bin/expect" >&2; exit 1; fi; exec /usr/bin/expect tests/failure-review.pty.expect'
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun test && bun run build
